author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam visits the model shop of @LAIKAStudios, where Wildwood's intricate sets, props, and vehicles were meticulously designed and fabricated. It's where Adam finds a strong kinship with fellow model makers, and where he learns how much innovation and mechanical problem-solving is needed to engineer miniatures to support and push forward the art of stop-motion animation. 

Wildwood is in theaters October 23rd and tickets are available at: https://wildwoodmovie.com/
Adam Savage Meets the Stop-Motion Puppets of LAIKA Studios: https://youtu.be/9stm18DFD08

Shot by Joey Fameli and Josh Self
Edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
